question: Where to stand so that placing a finished building waives only IsBuildingAllowed's research test, for CanDeployIn alone.

addresses.name: CanDeployIn_AskIsBuildingAllowed
addresses.comment: `call 0xDFFC0` (E8 DB 1A F6 FF) in CBuildingDeployment::CanDeployIn: CCountry::IsBuildingAllowed asked with ECX the country and the building ([edi+0x38]) and province pushed at 0x17E4DC. BiceLib's PlaceUnresearchedBuildings jumps from here to a stub that raises a flag around the same call, so the research test (IsBuildingAllowed_ResearchTest) is waived for this caller only. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-bicelibsites.md, section 7.1.
addresses.evidence: Decoded 0x17E4D9..0x17E4ED: `mov ecx,[edi+0x38]; push ebx; push ecx; mov ecx, esi; call 0x4DFFC0`. IsBuildingAllowed ends `ret 8` (its record), so the stub's own call consumes the same two arguments.

addresses.name: IsBuildingAllowed_ResearchTest
addresses.comment: `cmp byte ptr [eax+edx], 0; jne 0xE000B` (80 3C 10 00 75 15), the first of CCountry::IsBuildingAllowed's refusals: EAX the building's index (CBuilding +0x54, 0xDFFDD), EDX technology_status (+0xDF8) -> +0x28C, the buildings research has given. 0xDFFF6 (`xor al, al`) is the refusal, 0xE000B the rest of the checks. BiceLib's PlaceUnresearchedBuildings passes it while CanDeployIn_AskIsBuildingAllowed's flag is up. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-bicelibsites.md, section 7.1.
addresses.evidence: Decoded 0xDFFDA..0xDFFF8 in the vanilla exe. The function's record names this check (1) and the array building_available.

addresses.name: Hook_PlaceBuildingCheck
addresses.comment: In CBuildingDeployment::CanDeployIn: `test al, al; je 0x17E5B7` (84 C0 0F 84 CA 00 00 00, vanilla) on CCountry::IsBuildingAllowed's answer, called at 0x17E4E0 with the building [edi+0x38]; EDI the deployment, EBX the province. 0x17E5B7 is the refusal, 0x17E4ED the way on. **No longer hooked** (2026-11-07): BiceLib's PlaceUnresearchedBuildings stood here and replaced the answer with a cut-down level test, skipping all six of IsBuildingAllowed's checks; it now waives only the research test, at CanDeployIn_AskIsBuildingAllowed and IsBuildingAllowed_ResearchTest. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-bicelibsites.md, section 7.
addresses.evidence: As before; the DLL no longer writes these bytes.
addresses.revises: said BiceLib hooks here; it now stands at 0x17E4E0 and 0xDFFF0 instead
